title: 1574. Shortest Subarray to be Removed to Make Array Sorted

examples.explanation: The shortest subarray we can remove is [10,4,2] of length 3. The remaining elements after that will be [1,2,3,3,5] which are sorted. Another correct solution is to remove the subarray [3,10,4].
Since the array is strictly decreasing, we can only keep a single element. Therefore we need to remove a subarray of length 4, either [5,4,3,2] or [4,3,2,1].
The array is already non-decreasing. We do not need to remove any elements.
